items.title: Introducing automatic version upgrades for AWS Glue jobs
items.summary: Today we're announcing automatic version upgrades for AWS Glue jobs. Set a job's version to auto, and AWS Glue checks for breaking changes, asks for your approval, then moves the job to the latest stable version and validates the upgraded runs. Learn how auto upgrade works and how to use it across a fleet of jobs with an AI agent.
items.creator: Keerthi Chadalavada
